audit.whatIsWrong: Layers disagreed on rows 3-6: full had Skill/Skill/Kassadin/Kassadin, content had Mel on all 7 (packet flags Mel 7/7 vs 46.4% WR).
audit.why: Mel dominates pre-6 (Kassadin has no ranged trade tool), spikes 6 first, but Kassadin's Rod of Ages plus rank 2-3 Riftwalk (5/3.5/2s) out-scales — the classic reason the WR sits at 46.4%.
audit.corrected: Rows 3-4 moved full-side to Mel (content already Mel), rows 5-6 moved content win[] to Kassadin (full already Kassadin); whys rewritten on all four rows.

audit.why: Spikes correct: Mel's pre-6 abuse window, first-item timing before his Rod of Ages, and his late-game R-chain phase are all present in content spikes[].

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldowns field had no digits; Do's/Don'ts bodies were pasted tradeGood/tradeBad; the Nether Blade auto-reset burst tell and the Q-magic-shield-before-commit interaction were absent.
audit.why: Riftwalk is 5/3.5/2s with stacking mana cost; Null Sphere is 9-7s and grants a magic-damage shield; Nether Blade is a 7s auto reset — its wind-up is the step-back cue. Riftwalk and Nether Blade are not projectiles, so Rebuttal only returns Null Sphere.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns rewritten with numbers; bleed bullets replaced with the W-reset tell and the non-projectile Rebuttal warning.

audit.whatIsWrong: The kit flags Kassadin's Q as an interruptible channel, but Riot's own text says Null Sphere INTERRUPTS channels — the derived flag misfires.
audit.why: Trust the description over the flag per calibration rules; did not claim Solar Snare cancels his Q.
audit.corrected: No edit made asserting the false interaction; noted for the missing-interactions dataset.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — volley every wave contact and bank the overwhelm stacks on his health bar.
edits.after: Deny CS through 4-5 — he is the weakest early laner mid, and every missed wave delays his 6.

edits.before: Golden Eclipse online — the execute threshold turns your chip war into a countdown he can see.
edits.after: You spike 6 first: Snare stops the blink follow-up and Golden Eclipse executes early Riftwalks.

edits.before: Luden's spike: snare-volley chunks half bars and the execute cleans the remainder. Force contacts.
edits.after: His Rod of Ages comes online and each blink costs less than it hurts — stop trading, start ending.

edits.before: Late Mel is a counter-artillery battery: reflect their poke, snare their dive, and execute the chipped.
edits.after: Late his R is 2s: he blinks onto your backline at will — only a banked Solar Snare or Zhonya's answers.

edits.before: First item lands well before his Rod of Ages, so your lead only widens.
edits.after: First item, Rod of Ages stacking begins and his all-in starts beating yours.

edits.before: At two items you're still ahead of his scaling curve if you've pressed the early advantage.
edits.after: At two items his Riftwalk chains and a stacked Rod out-burst you unless you're far ahead.

edits.before: - Kassadin Riftwalk: matchup-defining — His mobility spike — the lane is decided before it scales. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Rebuttal like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Kassadin Riftwalk: 5s at rank 1, 2s at max — the stacking mana cost is his real limit; punish right after a blink. - His Q shield sits on a 9s timer — force it out before you commit. - Guard Rebuttal like a fifth summoner.

edits.before: Q-volley the last-hit, bank the overwhelm stacks, and keep W glowing — the chip is free while his best spells are hostages.
edits.after: His W Nether Blade wind-up is the burst tell — the glow plus one step back makes the melee reset whiff and costs you nothing.

edits.before: Burning Rebuttal on chip and then eating the full rotation it existed to return — the reflect is the matchup; spend it like a verdict.
edits.after: Riftwalk and Nether Blade are not projectiles — Rebuttal only returns his Null Sphere; the rest of his burst walks straight through it.

notes: Kit-flag error to report upstream: Kassadin Q carries the 'channel: interruptible' derived flag but Riot's text says Null Sphere interrupts channels — the flag misfires, and the _missing 'channel-interruptible' rule for this matchup is built on it; I did not write the Snare-cancels-Q claim.
